text: Our debate workflow must make participants, interaction, agreement, cost, and stopping rules explicit rather than treating multi-agent discussion as a black-box vote.
Agent agreement cannot by itself establish novelty, benchmark validity, or scientific truth; each position needs evidence and a decisive test.

ArtifactRole should carry the primary claim only if responsibility, later assignment, independent roots, and full cost are observable; this remains a decision candidate rather than an activated benchmark decision.
Orca can provide durable Run/Task/Dispatch coordination, but a worker startup that is unverified cannot be counted as a completed scientific debate.
